{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, check if any revenue values contain commas
print(f"Revenue values with commas: {df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).sum()}")

# Strip commas and convert to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_count = (completed_df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders in completed set: {qa_count}")

# Remove QA orders if any
if qa_count > 0:
    completed_df = completed_df[completed_df['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_df['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Output
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (after removing QA): {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
